{{Quote|As you wish, my eager apprentices. We shall remove this thorn from Malak's side, once, and for all.|Sith Master|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
A [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Master served the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. He was in charge of the [[Sith Embassy]] on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], and was also responsible for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] education of several young [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]].

When [[Darth Malak]] took the Sith Empire from [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], the Master swore his allegiance to the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. A year later, when the amnesic Revan and his allies perpetrated the Sith Embassy, this Dark Jedi Master allowed two of his Selkath apprentices to attack them. The Master recognized Revan and battled the amnesiac and his allies but was ultimately struck down due to his overconfidence.

A [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] recording the Dark Jedi Master's dealings was shown to the Selkath, convincing them to reconsider whom they were dealing with.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', if the player has [[Jolee Bindo]] or [[HK-47]] with them when they first encounter the Dark Jedi Master, they will each make a comment in the situation.
